comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable damper versus load four connector modules into a spring-open hinged frame and latch it shut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses hex-key insertion, collar adjustment, and controlled tightening; record repeatedly aligns and inserts modules into keyed frame positions, then overcomes spring preload to close and click the frame.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe repeated stops and lock retention; record requires all four modules correctly seated and the frame fully latched without bent or displaced modules.
comparison.reason: Repeated keyed insertion plus spring-frame closure is a different tested ability from iterative damping adjustment. Candidate response and drift thresholds are partly unspecified.
